description: This file defines the enum 'SavingsAccountStatusType' representing various states of a savings account. It includes methods for converting integers to enum values, checking the current state, and retrieving state-related information.

classes.name: SavingsAccountStatusType
classes.description: Enum representing the different statuses of a savings account, with utility methods for state checks and conversions.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to a corresponding SavingsAccountStatusType enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given status.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isSubmittedAndPendingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the status is 'submitted and pending approval'.

methods.name: isApplicationWithdrawnByApplicant
methods.description: Checks if the application was withdrawn by the applicant.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the account is active.

methods.name: isActiveOrAwaitingApprovalOrDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the account is either active, awaiting approval, or disbursal.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the account is closed, rejected, or withdrawn.

methods.name: isTransferInProgress
methods.description: Checks if a transfer is in progress.

methods.name: isTransferOnHold
methods.description: Checks if a transfer is on hold.

methods.name: isUnderTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the account is under transfer (either in progress or on hold).

methods.name: isMatured
methods.description: Checks if the account has matured.

methods.name: isPreMatureClosure
methods.description: Checks if the account is in pre-mature closure state.
